name: GP-200 V1.8.2 Linux sequential firmware protocol
authority: Public runtime description compiled into the app; no device permission or approval.

identity.version_provenance: Bootloader identity is not an application firmware-version confirmation.

section_sequence.request_reply: Safe frame of at least 6 bytes with raw[4] != 7E.
section_sequence.descriptor: F0 7E 48 02, 16 high/low nibbles for big-endian u32 length then u32 block count, F7; 21 bytes.
section_sequence.descriptor_and_block_reply: Safe frame of at least 6 bytes with raw[4] == 7F.
section_sequence.blocks: Checked integer ceil(length/chunk); absolute cursor starts at 0 in each section. Copy at most chunk bytes; pad with FF.
section_sequence.block_packet: F0 7E 48 04, cursor modulo 128, high/low nibbles of exactly chunk data bytes, two checksum nibbles, F7; 2*chunk+8 bytes.
section_sequence.checksum: Wrapping u8 sum of transmitted data nibbles, including FF padding; exclude header, index and checksum.
section_sequence.terminator_reply: Safe frame of at least 6 bytes with raw[4] == 7F.
section_sequence.next: Repeat announcement/request/descriptor/blocks/terminator for all four sections in the listed order.

terminal_sequence.reply: Safe frame with opcode 03 or 07 and an even body of nibbles <= 0F; decoded body remains opaque.
terminal_sequence.opcode_03: Retain observation without an offer or deadline extension.
terminal_sequence.opcode_07: Offer finish control F0 7E 48 09 F7 once.
terminal_sequence.finish: Full write/drain means host finished unverified; it proves no device persistence or contents.

host_policy.deadlines: Absolute monotonic deadlines; unrelated traffic never extends a phase.
host_policy.pairing: Retain full write/drain and phase-appropriate raw receive decision durably before the next action.
host_policy.failure: Stop on malformed status, write/drain uncertainty, reader loss, cancellation, timeout or target-binding change; retain recovery hold.
host_policy.unkeyed_status_limit: Delayed old statuses cannot be distinguished from valid replies during later actions.

admission_and_completion.entry: Explicit current normal capture/loss review and same-owner entry approval.
admission_and_completion.query: Fresh target binding and separate live boot-query review approval.
admission_and_completion.transfer: Fresh boot identity/chunk, exact retained image and contract, separate current transfer approval.
admission_and_completion.recovery: Checked original local history, new complete-image review from section/block zero; no imported-journal resume.
admission_and_completion.return: Fresh normal identity/current/globals reads, fresh manual pedal application-version V1.8.2 report, original owner retirement and durable closure.
admission_and_completion.contents: Installed IR audio, preservation and restored contents require separate evidence; completion alone does not verify them.
